definitions.gloss: to consider; to take into account; in light of
definitions.explanation: To reflect upon past events, precedents, or circumstances and use them as a basis for judgment or action. A formal expression used in written and official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}みる。
examples.english: To take past cases into consideration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}みて、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In light of the current situation, the plan needs to be reconsidered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{情勢|じょうせい}→情勢：12739_jousei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}み、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: In light of the international situation, the government decided to implement new measures.

notes:
USAGE:
{鑑|かんが}みる is a formal, literary verb. It almost always takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}みる (in light of ~, considering ~). The conjunctive form ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}み is frequently used in official documents and formal announcements.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Despite looking like it could be godan, {鑑|かんが}みる conjugates as an ichidan verb: {鑑|かんが}みる → {鑑|かんが}みて → {鑑|かんが}みた.
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}みる (in light of ~)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}みて (considering ~ — te-form)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}み (considering ~ — formal conjunctive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}みる (in view of circumstances)
- ⟦{前例|ぜんれい}→前例：11790_zenrei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}みる (in light of precedent)
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鑑|かんが}みる (considering the changes of the times)
